subject: Coordinating Hosted API sandbox demo for QuickCommerce trial
messages:
From: Alexis Romero <alexis@quickcommerce.io>
To: support@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Interested in a quick Hosted API sandbox demo

Hi team,

I signed up for the hosted API trial this morning (QuickCommerce, I'm Alexis — Head of Platform). We're evaluating ways to improve search relevance and customer support summarization. I spun up the sandbox but would like a short walkthrough of the Hosted API endpoints, limits, and recommended batching patterns for real-time storefront use.

Can someone run a 30-minute walkthrough next week? Prefer mornings PST. I'll invite our backend lead (Sam) if we lock a slot.

Thanks,
Alexis Romero
Head of Platform | QuickCommerce
alexis@quickcommerce.io

--
Sent from my phone
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alexis Romero <alexis@quickcommerce.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick Hosted API sandbox demo

Hi Alexis — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood. I'm Diego on the PLG support/SDR side. Thanks for signing up. Happy to run the 30-min sandbox walkthrough and show the Hosted API best practices for low-latency storefront calls.

A few quick questions so we make the session concrete:
- Who will attend from your side (titles)?
- Do you want a focus on generation (summaries) or embeddings/search pipelines?
- Are there any IP/contract constraints or a procurement gate we should know about?

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue, Dec 1, 9:30–10:00am
- Wed, Dec 2, 10:30–11:00am
- Thu, Dec 3, 8:30–9:00am

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and I'll loop in an AE/engineer. I'll attach a short demo brief and send a calendar invite once we pick a time.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com

Attachment: quickcommerce-demo-brief.pdf (1 page)
From: Alexis Romero <alexis@quickcommerce.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick Hosted API sandbox demo

Thanks Diego —
Attendees: me (Head of Platform) and Sam Thomas (Sr Backend Engineer). We'd like the session to cover embeddings/search first, then a short segment on generation for support replies. No procurement gates yet.

All three proposed slots look tight for Sam. He asked if there's anything after 4pm PST on Dec 2 or any time on Dec 3 after 11am PST. We can do 45 minutes if that helps.

Appreciate the brief attachment.

-Alexis

Alexis / Sam — thanks for the quick reply. Monica (our Solutions AE) is cc'd; she'll join to cover production questions and next steps.

Per Sam's availability, I can do:
- Thu, Dec 3, 11:30–12:15pm PST (45 minutes) — preferred
- Wed, Dec 2, 4:15–5:00pm PST (45 minutes) — alternate

I'll pencil in Thu Dec 3, 11:30am PST and send a calendar invite. Please reply if you'd rather take the earlier Dec 2 slot. Agenda (45m):
1) Quick intros (5m)
2) Embeddings/search pattern + demo with token and latency notes (20m)
3) Generation for support replies and safety knobs (10m)
4) Q&A + next steps / sandbox access tweaks (10m)

Attachments: redwood-sandbox-invite.ics (calendar file), quickcommerce-demo-brief.pdf

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez

Hi Alexis / Sam — Monica here. Excited to meet you both. I'll prepare a short production checklist (latency SLOs, autoscale guidance, and quantization suggestions) and have a solutions brief ready to share during the call. If you can drop a short note about your average request size (payload tokens) and expected qps, that will help tailor the demo.

Diego — can you confirm which environment (sandbox token) you'll share for them to test after the session? Also will we capture a recording and upload to their HubSpot record?

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Solutions AE, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Perfect — Thu Dec 3, 11:30am PST works for us.
Quick answers:
- Attendees: Alexis Romero (Head of Platform), Sam Thomas (Sr Backend Engineer)
- Average request: ~150 tokens payload, responses ~120–250 tokens depending on summarization depth
- Expected peak qps for trial: 5–10 (we'll scale after we validate latency)

Diego — appreciate the invite. Please send the calendar file and a short recording after. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Alexis
